name: BRKTA Design System Component Registry
description: Machine-readable registry of all BRKTA design system components with file paths across all packages.

components.name: Icon Motion

panel-left.semantic: Toggle or navigate a left panel

components.notes: Shared CSS motion with parent-triggered [data-brkta-button], [data-brkta-sidebar-item], and .brkta-icon-motion-trigger selectors. All variants are currentColor-neutral and reduced-motion compatible. Framework wrappers remain implementation-owned.

showCollapseToggle.description: Whether the wrapper renders the collapse/expand toggle control

components.name: Data Table
components.notes: Owner-approved 2026-10-21: optional cellTemplates keyed by column, with row/column/value context in Angular and React. Unspecified cells retain plain text.
